input.summary: Insert a mutual aggregate liability cap of 12 months' fees after Section 11.5, with uncapped carve-outs for indemnification, Article 9 confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement waives consequential damages but contains no aggregate liability cap, leaving both Parties exposed without limit. We added a mutual cap at twelve months' fees, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: Cap on Liability. Except for (a) a Party's indemnification obligations under this Article 11, (b) a Party's breach of its obligations under Article 9, and (c) a Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by AbbVie under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.
